node.title: The rank-nine pair-core plane cap extends to nine cells
node.closure: nine-coordinate affine-plane geometry and adjacent-integer resource audit
node.statement: For actual original-row records in one affine owner plane fixed by a nine-coordinate evaluation-rank-nine set, the common plane core has size at least nine. If it is below 134944, the ordered-pair petal argument gives g(g-1)<=981105*(2097152-9)=2057517483015 and the unchanged integer cap g<=1434405. Every larger nine-cell plane shares at least 134944 received coordinate pairs.
